title: Warm White French Tahini Souffle
description: A sour and shattering French Provence dish featuring tahini paste, grilled to perfection in a yakimono style, perfect for a brunch mood, this souffle is a unique and delicious treat, friendly to those who avoid onion and garlic.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono grill to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the egg yolks, lemon juice, grated lemon zest, salt, and sugar until well combined.
In a separate large bowl, beat the egg whites until stiff peaks form.
In another bowl, whisk together the tahini paste and melted butter until smooth.
Add the water to the tahini mixture and whisk until well combined.
Gently fold the egg whites into the tahini mixture until no white streaks remain.
Add the egg yolk mixture to the tahini mixture and fold until well combined.
Pour the mixture into 4 buttered souffle dishes and place on the yakimono grill.
Bake for 20 minutes or until puffed and golden brown.
Remove from the grill and let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
